scenario: Kate plans a team talent show — 'we are one big family, so we all share a talent!' Everyone says what they can and can't do and what they like doing. Pol can do yoga and loves cooking healthy food. Den can't sing at all, but he likes organising and can fix any computer. Alex jokes that he can sleep anywhere and enjoys 'resting' at work (four kids at home). Valery says he can't stay after six o'clock and doesn't like parties. Peter is shy but surprises everyone — he can juggle three oranges. Kate can't decide, so everyone wins. Warm, light humour. Use lots of 'can / can't' for ability and 'like/love/enjoy + -ing'. Short A2 sentences.
